text:
maria: Heads-up — vendor 'CloudForge' reported they were billed twice for March reserved capacity and one invoice is missing the 'data-transfer' line. Invoice numbers: INV-2026-0312 and INV-2026-0312_DUP. Total on dup = $12,480 but should be $6,240. @jonas can you take a look?
jonas: on it. can you drop the vendor PDF into the ticket?
jonas: quick check in billing DB — i see two rows for customer_id=CF-77, same billing_period=2026-03. one has 3 line items, the other 2.
ashley: any quick revert? can we void the duplicate and reissue before they dispute? :grimacing:
jonas: running a query now:
```sql
SELECT id, invoice_num, amount_total_cents, line_items_count, created_at
FROM invoices
WHERE customer_id='CF-77' AND billing_period='2026-03';
```
jonas: results (export):
```text
INV-2026-0312 | 202603-01 | 624000 | 3 | 2026-03-16 10:05:12
INV-2026-0312_DUP | 202603-01 | 1248000 | 2 | 2026-03-16 10:06:04
```
jonas: looks like invoice-generator job ig-20260316-42 retried and inserted a second invoice with a partial payload — missing data-transfer line from usage-collector.
ashley: was there an outage in usage-collector around 10:05-10:07? @maria any vendor notes about timing?
maria: vendor PDF shows payments pending. they want corrected invoice or credit, please escalate. attaching to ticket now.
jonas: proposed immediate actions:
1) void the duplicate invoice record (mark voided, don't delete)
2) regenerate invoice with full line items from usage snapshot or re-run usage-collector for that window
3) issue a credit note if the dup already hit payment processor
4) add idempotent upsert / dedupe by invoice_num + billing_period in generator
ashley: also add an alert on invoice-generator: retries >1 within 5m and missing line_items_count mismatch >20% vs expected.
jonas: i'm going to create a quick PR to enforce upsert and a DB unique constraint. i'll also open a task to reprocess affected customers.
jonas: creating issue FIN-487 and tagging ops, billing, and infra. https://redwood.internal/issue/FIN-487
maria: thanks, please cc billing@cloudforge.com and include corrected invoice when reissued. they prefer a credit note rather than a refund.
invoiceman-bot: Incident created: FIN-487 — Duplicate invoice generated for customer CF-77. Priority: P2. Assigned: jonas.
ashley: can we also whitelist CloudForge so we don't auto-send payment reminders while this is active?
jonas: yes, I'll add a temporary billing_hold flag on CF-77 and block dunning. doing that now.
maria: appreciate the fast response. please post updates in this thread and in the FIN ticket. :heart:
jonas: update 1738504345 — duplicate marked voided, billing_hold applied, regeneration in progress. will follow up once new invoice ready.
